keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Netherlands 1, Greece 0. Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Netherlands 2, Greece 0. Tijjani Reijnders (Netherlands) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Joey Veerman with a through ball.
Goal! Netherlands 3, Greece 0. Tijjani Reijnders (Netherlands) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Donyell Malen.
Goal! Netherlands 4, Greece 0. Tijjani Reijnders (Netherlands) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Denzel Dumfries.
Goal! Netherlands 5, Greece 0. Jurriën Timber (Netherlands) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Donyell Malen.
First Half ends, Netherlands 5, Greece 0.
Substitution, Netherlands. Teun Koopmeiners replaces Frenkie de Jong.
Second Half begins Netherlands 5, Greece 0.
Goal! Netherlands 6, Greece 0. Jurriën Timber (Netherlands) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Netherlands 7, Greece 0. Donyell Malen (Netherlands) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Denzel Dumfries.
Substitution, Netherlands. Ruben van Bommel replaces Cody Gakpo.
Substitution, Netherlands. Gjivai Zechiël replaces Tijjani Reijnders.
Substitution, Greece. Tasos Douvikas replaces Fotis Ioannidis.
Substitution, Greece. Tasos Bakasetas replaces Vangelis Pavlidis.
Substitution, Greece. Giorgos Masouras replaces Konstantinos Karetsas.
Substitution, Greece. Georgios Vagiannidis replaces Christos Tzolis.
Substitution, Greece. Ilias Koutsoupias replaces Nectarios Triantis.
Substitution, Netherlands. Ian Maatsen replaces Jurriën Timber.
Substitution, Netherlands. Noa Lang replaces Crysencio Summerville.
